FN-2T5PII-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 215
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/26/2023
Senate Bill 215 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of counties and
municipalities that adopt and enforce building codes to enact procedures allowing for the
installation and activation of temporary-permanent electricity or gas. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
